subject: Recommitment playbook kickoff — Horizon AI renewal & expansion (roles + usage snapshot)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recommitment playbook kickoff — Horizon AI renewal & expansion (roles + usage snapshot)

Hi Lydia — thanks again for your time last week. Per our renewal cadence I put together a short recommitment playbook to align on scope, success metrics, and the timeline to close and expand. High-level goals: 1) secure renewal for annual subscription (current term ends 2027-06-30), 2) identify two pilot expansion workloads (embedding-based semantic search and batch summarization), 3) agree on success metrics and evaluation criteria for the pilot.

Attached: MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx — a proposed mutual action plan with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Please review the stakeholders and milestones section (tab: Owners & Milestones) and let me know if any names/roles should be added.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 minutes):
- Introductions & charter (5m)
- Current usage snapshot & constraints (7m)
- Pilot scope and acceptance criteria (10m)
- Timeline to decision + procurement steps (5m)

Action items for the kickoff prep:
- Horizon: confirm internal stakeholders who will own evaluation & procurement (we need an evaluation lead + procurement contact)
- Redwood: share a short evaluation checklist and baseline usage report (I’ve attached a draft and will include Marcus and Camila on technical context)

Suggested times for kickoff: Tuesday 2027-04-21 10:00am PT or Wednesday 2027-04-22 2:00pm PT — I’ve put a calendar link here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-kickoff. If neither works, propose alternatives.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 7 rows — owners/milestones tab)
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommitment playbook kickoff — Horizon AI renewal & expansion (roles + usage snapshot)

Thanks Naomi — this looks helpful. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Please add Carlos Mendes (VP Engineering) as a technical stakeholder — he’ll sign off on pilot success criteria.
- Procurement will need to be in the loop; I’m copying procurement@horizonai.com (they’ll handle contract timing).
- I’m attaching a brief usage extract (usage_Q1_2027.csv) that shows token volume and embedding calls for Q1; there’s a spike on March 12 tied to an internal test.

Two asks before kickoff:
1) Can Redwood call out a recommended evaluation checklist for the embedding pilot? We want clear pass/fail criteria (latency, relevance, cost delta).
2) Can you confirm whether dedicated capacity or hosted API is recommended for the initial pilot? Latency and inference cost will drive the decision.

Either proposed kickoff time works for me; favoring Tue 4/21 at 10am PT.

— Lydia Park
Head of Product, Horizon AI
lydia.park@horizonai.com

Attachment: usage_Q1_2027.csv (CSV, 3 columns: date, api_calls, embedding_calls)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@horizonai.com
Date: 2027-04-14T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommitment playbook kickoff — Horizon AI renewal & expansion (roles + usage snapshot)

Hi Lydia — appreciate the quick response and the usage extract. I’ve updated the MAP with Carlos as the technical approver and added a procurement checkpoint on the timeline (see attached MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx). Key clarifications below so the kickoff is focused and actionable: 

- Evaluation checklist (short):
  * Latency: p95 < 220ms for reranking/embedding calls in the pilot region
  * Quality: MAP@10 improvement >= 12% versus baseline reranker (we’ll schedule a short eval set run)
  * Cost: cost per 1k tokens <= 70% of current hosted baseline or documented trade-off for dedicated pool
  * Ops: tracing enabled + sampling for 2 weeks during pilot

- Hosting recommendation: Based on your Q1 volume and the embedding spike, we recommend starting the pilot on Hosted API to move quickly, with a parallel performance test on Redwood Dedicated for the 2-week evaluation window; that will give you a direct comparison for latency and unit cost. Marcus will own the tech-run and delivery of the dedicated test harness.

- Owners (from MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx):
  * Horizon evaluation lead: Lydia Park
  * Horizon technical approver: Carlos Mendes
  * Horizon procurement: procurement@horizonai.com
  * Redwood pilot owner: Marcus Lin
  * Redwood success lead: Rishi Malhotra

Next steps before kickoff (owner / due):
- Horizon: confirm Carlos’ availability for the kickoff and any additional stakeholder names (Lydia / Tue 4/20 EOD)
- Redwood: provision short performance test on Dedicated and share test plan (Marcus / 4/20 EOD)
- Both: agree on kickoff time — tentatively Tue 4/21 10:00am PT (accept calendar invite if good)

I’ve also added a short HubSpot deal link to the MAP: https://hubspot.com/deals/HZN-2027-045 for your procurement team.

Thanks — Camila and I will prep the technical snapshot and Rishi will be standing by for success metric alignment. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, owners/milestones updated)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommitment playbook kickoff — Horizon AI renewal & expansion (roles + usage snapshot)

Got it — I’ll prepare the Dedicated perf test harness and an internal runbook for the 2-week comparison (latency/cost/kv-cache settings to vary). Marcus, looping you to coordinate infra. I’ll drop the test plan in the shared drive and link it to the MAP before EOD Tue 4/20.

— Camila
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
